smallest_supported_claim: At n=6 the exact two-sided paired test rejects at 0.05 only if all six tasks are discordant in the same direction. Run79 is a development smoke test, not an adequately powered test of the 10-percentage-point product threshold.
limitations: Power scenarios are hypothetical probabilities, not observed model outcomes.
Assumes independent identically distributed task pairs.
No capable-model inference and no frozen holdout access.
